slides.headline: what's coming in *december*
slides.dek: nine dates, one month, a lot of honest conversations

slides.headline: *venus* goes into scorpio. flirting gets a lot less casual
slides.body: venus spends the rest of the month in scorpio. astrologers read it as all-or-nothing love: fewer people, more depth, zero patience for small talk.

slides.headline: new moon in *sagittarius*: start the honest version
slides.body: the moon goes dark at 17° sagittarius. a good night to name what you actually want, out loud, to yourself first.

slides.headline: *saturn* and neptune go direct. jupiter turns back in leo
slides.body: three planets change direction in three days. it reads as a gear change: what was stuck starts moving, and what was growing fast slows down to check itself.

slides.headline: *capricorn* season: less talk, more plans
slides.body: the sun enters capricorn on the solstice weekend, and mercury follows on dec 25. good for saying what you mean and booking the date.

slides.headline: full moon in *cancer*: say the soft thing out loud
slides.body: the last full moon of 2026 lands two days before christmas. astrologers read cancer moons as home, family and who you actually miss.

slides.headline: if you only remember one date: *dec 23*
slides.body: save this. plan the conversation, not the outfit. there is always an 11:11.
